lede: The work to run @accordproject/concerto-core 5.0.0 on the Rust engine (concerto-rust, through concerto-wasm), from the tracker's creation on 24 September 2026 to 1 October 2026 16:30 UTC. It was coordinated from issue accordproject/concerto-rust#29 by one coordinator and three workers (local-matt, cloud-2, cloud-3; cloud-main in phase 0). Every figure below links back to an issue, PR, commit or benchmark file.
status_note: Behavioural parity holds (0 oracle regressions; the baselined failures are intended R1 breaking changes). The single major release (R1) now carries most breaking fixes. BC-19's strict shape check no longer dominates loading after BC-19-a/b. D1 is 39.7% against a 70% bar, and the web bundle is about 16× the size of v5's.

tiles.n: 10 open in scope: 3 in review (P5-53, P5-63, P5-72), 2 awaiting a decision (P5-39, P5-62), 5 backlog (P5-44..P5-47, #260). 14 post-migration issues open.
RUST only 19.1%, from the P5-64 re-audit after the R1 changes (30 Sep 19:27Z). It was 45.3% before the test-support removal and the engine-shim reclassification.
Of 16,242 fixtures, 0 regressions. 271 baselined failures are intended R1 breaking changes (strict DateTime, BC-19, BC-39/40, BC-02, the P5-63 fixes); 2,110 unsupported ops stay TS.

P5-62's draft harness (conformance#42), 30 Sep: 151 run and passed, 7 upstream @skip, against the integration branch. On conformance main it is 69/116, because steps and the instance runner are missing.

Geometric means through the TS API in one same-run cloud sweep (1 Oct): introspection 1.48×, serialisation 1.84×, instance creation 1.68×, validation 2.05×. 19 of 73 rows at or below TS; crate-direct 0.31-0.57×.
E1 with keepNames, P5-72 (+3.6% on P5-60; the .wasm grew 102 KB from P5-63, P5-66 and P5-69). 722 KB was possible with the no-API-change wins (P5-39), which wait on a decision.

cov_note: Sources: D1 from migration/ledger/SUMMARY.md at each integration-branch commit; oracle from concerto-core/tests/oracle/baseline.tsv at each merge (unsupported = corpus total − pass − fail, which matches every published figure); conformance from the Rust-native harness runs cited on each point. The D1 drops on 27-28 Sep are changes in how rows are classified, not code moving back to TS.
perf_note: Two harnesses feed these charts: run-ts (the 500-instance workload and model load) and the P5-15 sweep (per model set). Their numbers are not directly comparable. Everything measured after 29 Sep 12:00Z ran in a cloud container; load, load + validate, validateAst and parseNamespace still have laptop figures as their latest (P6-04, P5-20). P5-48's table has both TS-API and crate columns; only TS-API values are drawn. The P5-42 figures come from a design run built without wasm-opt. P5-73's new ModelManager result is recorded as absolute times only (314 → 193 µs), because × TS for that op is not comparable across runs. P5-72's bench files (concerto#1464) are still an unmerged draft; P5-60's were squash-merged as 87b8f3c55.
wins: Differential oracle at zero unexpected failures

The native harness went from 1,966 passing fixtures (24 Sep) to 13,921 with 0 failures by 26 Sep, and 14,132 once 211 previously uncompared fixtures were brought in (#265, 27 Sep), with 0 regressions reported at every merge.
P5-08 promoted oracle and fuzz cases into concerto-conformance: 75 scenarios became 151, all passing on the Rust-backed engine.
Performance moved from 6-100× slower to near parity for instance work
fromJSON went from 14.9× (P5-04) to about 0.9× (P5-22); Resource validate from 30.8× to 1.3-2.1×; getNamespaces repeated reads from 23× to 0.3-2.5× (P5-29).
20 DV rows in DIVERGENCES.md, each classified (TS bug, engine, maintainer-accepted), and a breaking-changes plan (BC-02..BC-45, BR-rows) with R1/R2/R3/RB releases.
Median of about 1.5 hours from claim to close across 169 claimed tasks; 233 PRs merged into the integration branches of concerto (102) and concerto-rust (131).
One major release, fixes pulled forward
On 29 Sep the maintainer folded R3 into R1. That day BC-05, BC-10, BC-28, BC-41, BC-46, BC-47, BC-48 and BC-50 shipped in the Rust engine, and BC-02, BC-17..BC-20, BC-39 and BC-40 were started.
Instance work at or near parity, crate faster than TS
In P5-60's same-run sweep, instance creation went from 10.5× to 1.79× TS through the TS API, and every category is faster than TS crate-direct (0.30-0.81×). 46 of 57 crate rows are at or below TS.

After BC-19-a/b (P5-68, P5-69): new ModelFile 18.8-30.0× → 5.4-7.4×, addModelFile 9.2-12.3× → 3.3-5.8×, extract* 3.6-12.4× → 2.1-4.7×, decorateModels 1.2-1.6× → 0.75-1.15× TS. The check now costs 1.11-1.25× on new ModelFile and is within noise elsewhere (P5-72).

P5-73 cut new ModelManager() from 314 µs to 193 µs (−38%) in a same-run benchmark, with flat controls. The earlier 1.26× TS ratio was partly a measurement artefact: TS 5.0.0's own time for this op varies with the sample count (110 µs at 300 samples, 366 µs at 30, 449 µs in P5-72).
challenges: The P5-03 adversarial review found 142 ledger rows marked RUST that made no engine call (#261). After reclassification and the P5-11 review (#276), D1 fell from 85.3% to 39.4%, then recovered to 45.3% after the 14 deferred ports.
P5-04 (26 Sep) measured the engine at 6×-100× slower through the public API. This opened a performance track (P5-06 to P5-42) that was paused once (26 Sep) and restarted (28 Sep).
Exact TS message parity was replaced on 27 Sep by 'same throw scenarios, same exception class' (P5-09), which re-classified earlier fuzz and oracle differences.
At least 15 adversarial-review FAIL verdicts sent tasks back (for example P4-10, P5-02 over several rounds, P5-05 T2a/T2c).
Merge checks ran a narrower test command
The concerto merge check ran a narrow test command without the lifted checks, so P5-34, P5-43 and P5-35 merged without the full core suite. Fixed upstream in 1f86bc13d (29 Sep).
cloud-3 claimed backlog issues that had not been released (P5-37, P5-39 and P5-41, on 29 Sep at 13:28Z), and merged measure-only or design PRs (P5-22, P5-42).
A Node 18 shell made the concerto ESM smoke check look broken; verification now pins Node 22.
BC-19's shape check made loading slower (resolved)

At the P5-60 head, checkAstShape was 58-87% of new ModelFile/addModelFile time and 28-83% of DCS calls, and model loading was 7-8× TS. BC-19-a (P5-68) and BC-19-b (P5-69) removed most of that cost (see wins).
risks: P5-73 found that with new ModelManager, new ModelFile and addModelFile in one process, addModelFile can run 1.8-2.2× slower, from a V8 WeakMap stall on stages.set in engine/views.ts (about 120 µs per call). Not fixed yet; P5-72's other follow-ups (2-4) are deferred to the post-R1 performance milestone.
1,536.0 KB gzip, about 16× v5 (P5-72). The size wins and the browser loader (P5-44..P5-47) wait on the P5-39 decision.
39.7% after the P5-64 re-audit (30 Sep), against the 70% bar; the gate reports §0.4 as FAIL by maintainer decision (#276).
R1 now carries every breaking change

R1 holds strict DateTime and SemVer, strict AST shape (BC-19), validator exception classes (BC-39), unversioned-namespace rejection (BC-02) and the test-support removals; P5-63 adds six minor TS-bug fixes. BC-04/21/24/27/33/35/44/49 are still to decide.
DCO sign-off on two merge commits (#260) is left to the maintainer; 14 post-migration issues remain open, 6 of them fixed by the merged P5-63 but not yet closed.
gaps: No sourced values before the tracker existed
Work before 24 Sep 09:51Z is not on GitHub; phase-0 tasks were filed already in review, so their start times are the filing time.
baseline.tsv lists compared fixtures only; unsupported is corpus total minus pass minus fail. The corpus total (16,085, then 16,242) is from issue comments.
Performance ratios are only comparable within one run. There is no single recent run that covers every operation.
cloud-2 and cloud-3 session logs are rebuilt from GitHub activity; their start and end times are first and last visible activity, not session boundaries.
The Rust-native harness has four sourced runs: 24 Sep, 27 Sep and two on 30 Sep. The 27 Sep total (108) is computed as run plus @skip-rust, and that source does not state the upstream @skip count.

The coordinator and local-matt transcripts are covered up to 1 Oct 16:39Z (the 30 Sep 09:34Z to 1 Oct gap was filled from the transcripts on 1 Oct). Cloud workers have no transcripts; their logs come from GitHub.

timeline_extra.s: Merge policy: PRs into the integration branch that pass adversarial review and CI merge without human review.
Workers merge their own PRs; the coordinator stops merging and only verifies integration heads (after a double merge of P1-07b).
Workers ignore GitHub content from anyone except the maintainer account.
A third worker, cloud-3, joins and takes its first task.
New worker rules: no rebase or force-push of pushed branches; WASM checks for public Rust type changes.
cloud-2 winds down: no new work, only finishing existing jobs (later exceptions approved on #215 and #218).
Relayed-approvals rule: decisions relayed by a worker need the coordinator's confirmation before dependent merges.
Conformance PRs (P5-08a/b) kept as drafts for the maintainer to review and merge.
Lazy views brought back as planned work (P5-10a/b/c), a day after the lazy-views spike was accepted as no-go for parity.
Productivity rules: batch DECISION NEEDED questions under the mig:needs-decision label, a shared compile cache, and fast/full check tiers.
The local machine is in use by the maintainer: timed work such as benchmarks moves to cloud-3.
cloud-3 claimed P5-37, P5-39 and P5-41 while they were still in the backlog (not yet released by the coordinator).
P5-39 bundle analysis: the engine's web bundle is 1,485 KB gzip against v5's 89 KB; the no-API-change wins bring it to 722 KB. It also found that minified bundles break constructor.name checks.
Post-migration issues #356-#362 filed for the remaining TS behaviours in the breaking-changes plan (BC-17..BC-20, BC-39, BC-40, BC-44).
cloud-3 merged the P5-42 design/analysis PR (concerto-rust#363), after merging the measure-only P5-22 PRs earlier the same day.
One major release: Q2 answered, R3 folded into R1. R1 schedules BC-02, BC-05, BC-10, BC-17..BC-20, BC-28, BC-39 and BC-40 alongside BC-31, BC-41 and BC-46..BC-50; BC-34 becomes changelog-only.
P5-43 fixed the constructor.name minified-bundle bug found by P5-39 (an R1 web blocker).
Cross-platform research for the web decision: how other Rust-core libraries (Prisma, ICU4X, Automerge, Cedar, tree-sitter and others) ship to browsers, and why Prisma moved chatty work back to TS.
Merge-step check fixed upstream (1f86bc13d): it now runs the full core suite, including the lifted checks.
Maintainer scheduled the six minor-class TS-bug fixes for R1 as P5-63 (BC-01, BC-06, BC-08, BC-11, BC-12, BC-14), plus P5-64 (D1 re-audit) and P5-65 (R1 changelog and migration guide).

P5-60 same-run re-measure: 19 of 73 rows at or below TS through the TS API (5 before); model loading worse (4.99× to 8.31×) because of BC-19's shape check. DECISION NEEDED: BC-19-a and BC-19-b recommended before R1.
P5-64 re-audit of the D1 ledger after the R1 changes: 39.7% (RUST only 19.1%).
BC-19-a and BC-19-b filed for R1 (P5-68, P5-69) on the P5-60 recommendation.
P5-68 (BC-19-a) closed: the shape check is skipped for engine-written ASTs in the DCS result managers.
P5-60's bench results merged as a squash commit (concerto#1456, 87b8f3c55).
P5-69 (BC-19-b) closed: the shape check is folded into the strict typed read.
P5-72 same-run re-measure after BC-19-a/b: model loading 3.68× TS (7.32× at the P5-60 head), 19 of 73 rows at or below TS. Follow-up decision pending (options 1-5; 1 and 5 recommended).
P5-72 follow-ups 1 and 5 filed as P5-73 and P5-74; 2-4 deferred until after R1.
P5-74 merged: the bench scripts make their output directory absolute, so crate results are no longer lost.
P5-71 merged (BC-34): the ./dist/* export is removed from concerto-core in R1, with a new exports check; no consumers found across the accordproject org.

P5-73 merged: new ModelManager() 314 → 193 µs; TS 5.0.0's own time for this op varies with sample count, so its × TS is not comparable across runs. It also found a possible V8 WeakMap stall in addModelFile.
